title: Book One · Chapter 154: Leo Wants a Turn
story:
Leo has made twelve game cards. Ronan only asked for nine cards. Leo chose three extra places for the game. He spreads them across the desk and begins to explain.

Ronan is looking for Mum's name card. It is under his room plan. He moves Leo's cards and lifts the plan. He does not ask first.

Leo stops speaking.

“These are mine.”

“I need this paper.”

“You need every paper.”

Ronan looks up. Leo has put both hands over the game. His mouth is tight and he looks angry. Ronan has seen that face when Leo loses races.

“I am not taking your game.”

“You make every plan for it.”

Ronan almost speaks. They need a good plan for the room, he thinks. Then he sees the extra cards. He did not ask about the extra cards.

“Show me,” he says.

Leo does not move at first. Ronan puts his own plan away and sits back. Mei comes over and looks at their faces. “Should I come back later?” she asks. Leo says she can stay.

He explains the new cards. One shows a food shop. One shows the school gate. The third is a joke door. It does not go to a real place. The joke card makes Mei laugh. Ronan thinks visitors might enjoy it too. They must write JOKE beside this door. It must not send people the wrong way.

“I want to show the game to people,” Leo says.

“I thought we would take turns.”

“We can. But I made it. I want my own turn.”

Ronan thinks about Mum's card and Mei's drawings. He put their names beside their work. But he still planned to do most of the talking. Leo wants to explain his own game.

They draw three little spaces on the plan. Leo will look after the game at the start. Ronan will meet visitors at the map. Mei will stay near her pictures when she wants to explain them. Later they can change jobs. They must tell each other first. Then they can change places.

There must be breaks too. Leo wants to see the whole room as a visitor. Mei hopes her mother can come. She wants time to sit with her too. Ronan forgot his own break. They leave a space for his break too.

Miss Wu reads the plan at lunch. “What can we do if one person is late?” she asks. If Leo is late, they can keep the game closed. He can open it when he is ready. People can look at the pictures while they wait.

They write each child's times on a separate strip. They can change one strip. The rest of the plan can stay the same. Ronan asks Leo to read his own part aloud. Leo forgot to include a short break. He adds it now. Mei wants to stay near her pictures at first. She cannot stand by the door at the same time. They check her place on the plan. They fix that line before the plan is copied.

After school Ronan helps Leo put the cards in the crooked paper cover. This time he asks Leo first. Then he touches the cards. Leo hands him the three extra ones.

“You may read these first.”

The joke door says: OPEN THIS DOOR TO GO HOME EARLY. On the back it says: WRONG DOOR. YOU ARE STILL AT SCHOOL.

Ronan laughs. He has spent so long checking lists and places. He nearly forgot the game could make people laugh. He gives the cards back to Leo. They need a sign for the bag place. Could Leo draw that too? He asks him. Leo says yes, after his own homework. Ronan agrees to wait.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：take turns＝轮流；look after＝负责照看；break＝休息。

情节提示：crooked＝不平直的；strip＝纸条；aloud＝出声地。

理解：1. Leo 为什么不满意 Ronan 的安排？2. 三人怎样分配了展示开始时的任务？
